# Winter without a shopping list

Read the bean and apple notes before opening the seed catalogue. We need a few replacements, not a new growing system. [[Garden notebook]] helped stop a purchase by making the old experiments available. A useful notebook sometimes generates less activity. Leave a blank page for what the weather actually does.
